defs.def: not clean 肮脏的；龌龊的；污秽的

ex.s: Wear clothes that can get dirty.
A dirty stream, for example, often became clear after flowing through plants and along rocks where tiny creatures lived.
ex.t: 例如，一条污浊的小溪在流经植物和栖息着微小生物的岩石后，常常变得清澈。

ex.s: Most of them wore clothes that were torn and dirty.
ex.t: 大多数人穿着破旧脏污的衣服。

ex.s: If we drink dirty water, we can catch diseases from the bacteria and become ill.
ex.t: 如果我们喝了脏水，可能会因细菌感染疾病而生病。

ex.s: 34 On this day every year, countries around the world hold events to educate people about the problems of dirty water and that clean water is something that everyone should have around the world.
ex.t: 34 每年的这一天，世界各国举办活动，教育人们关于污水的问题，以及清洁的水是全世界每个人都应有的东西。

ex.s: And why is the water so dirty that it makes them sick?” Young Ryan thought, “Life is easy for me, but hard for those people.
ex.t: “为什么水这么脏，让他们生病？”小Ryan想，“对我来说生活是轻松的，但对他们来说却很艰难。”

ex.s: B: We should tell them it’s dirty and it can spread diseases.
ex.t: B：我们应该告诉他们水很脏，会传播疾病。

ex.s: And I never have to carry lots of heavy coins or dirty notes, or worry about losing my wallet–for the fourth time!
ex.t: 而且我永远不用担心携带大量沉重的硬币或脏兮兮的纸币，也不用担心第四次弄丢钱包！

ex.s: (The other person knows which car is dirty.) Open the window!
ex.t: （对方知道哪辆车是脏的。）打开窗户！

ex.s: Speaking of “dirty”, do you know that there are more germs on a coin than on a toilet seat?!
ex.t: 说到“肮脏”,你知道硬币上的细菌比马桶座位上的细菌还要多吗？

defs.def: connected with sex in an offensive way 下流的；色情的；黄色的；猥亵的
unpleasant or dishonest 令人厌恶的；卑鄙的；不诚实的

ex.s: The young banker who eats lunch at his desk is probably seen as a go-getter, while his colleagues who chat over a relaxed conference-room meal get dirty looks from the corner office.
ex.t: 那个在办公桌前吃午餐的年轻银行家可能被视为有上进心的人，而他在会议室轻松用餐的同事则会从角落办公室投来厌恶的目光。

defs.def: behaving in an unfair or aggressive way, especially because you want to win 不正当竞争的；不择手段的
rude and shocking 粗暴无礼的；恶劣的
